faqs.question: What is MoneyPool?
faqs.answer: MoneyPool is the crowdfunding solution in Donorfit. Your organisation creates a campaign for one project with a fundraising goal and deadline, and many supporters contribute towards it while everyone can follow the progress.

faqs.question: What happens when a campaign reaches its goal?
faqs.answer: The progress bar shows that the goal has been reached. Your organisation stays in charge of what happens next: you decide when to close the campaign and you carry out the project.

faqs.question: Does the organiser hold the money?
faqs.answer: Never. All funds go directly to the verified nonprofit organisation, which protects organisers and ensures contributors receive receipts.

faqs.question: Can contributors stay anonymous?
faqs.answer: Yes. Contributors can hide their name or amount from the public wall and still receive their private receipt.

faqs.question: How can people contribute?
faqs.answer: Through quick mobile payment links, SEPA Direct Debit or card.

cta.title: Create your first MoneyPool campaign
cta.body: Set a fundraising goal, share the campaign with your community and follow every contribution in one place.
